question: Giorgia Meloni recently become first Woman Prime Minister of which country?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Italy**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Giorgia Meloni became the first woman Prime Minister of Italy on **October 22, 2022.**
 
• She is the leader of the Brothers of Italy (FdI) political party, which is a** right-wing populist party.**
 
• She has served as the **president** of the European Conservatives and Reformists Party since 2020.
